Elena M: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting the internal release note and the short announce blurb for the v2.4.1 deploy tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final pin matrix (which models/endpoints we pin) and any last-minute rollback guidance.
Samir K: thanks! can you drop both short and long versions? I'll assemble the #all-hands snippet.
Elena M: Yep. Short (one-liner + impact):
Elena M: `Short: v2.4.1: runtime + batching improvements — lower gen latency by ~15% for long-context workloads. No schema changes.`
Elena M: Long (internal):
Elena M: ```
What's included: runtime kernel update, KV cache improvements, and batching tuning.
Impact: 10-20% latency improvement on L >= 2048, improved stability for Dedicated pools, and better fallback behavior when a model is temporarily OOS.
Action for eng: pin critical endpoints to model-legacy-v1 for 2 hours post-deploy if you observe regressions; contact #eng-oncall for hotfix rollbacks.
```
Dave R: Pin matrix suggestion: pin chat-prod -> model-chat-v2 (no pin), pin longgen-prod -> model-long-v1 pinned for 2h, pin rerank -> model-rerank-v1 (no pin).
Lee H: +1 to Dave, but request pin longgen-prod to model-long-v1-quant instead if quant perf matches — will confirm benchmarks in 30m.
Marco P: Ops note: change window is 09:00-10:30 PT. We'll run canary at 09:00 -> 09:20, then ramp. If canary error rate >1% or p95 latency regression >10% -> rollback.
deploy-bot: [deploy] canary start initiated by @Marco P at 1982468400. Targets: canary cluster (5% traffic). Logs: https://deploys.internal/1982468400
Samir K: For the internal announce, propose an accountability line: "On-call: @eng-oncall, Escalation: @eng-sre" — ok?
Elena M: good. Also adding a tiny 'what to watch' checklist:
Elena M: `1) increased 5xx on canary 2) p95 gen latency 3) error traces mentioning 'kv cache' or 'kernel compile'`
Lee H: If we see compile failures, immediate rollback. Also note: the runtime change sets max-batch-size default from 32 -> 48; if anyone needs 32 preserved, mention it in the thread now.
Dave R: Product asked for a customer-facing blurb too. Draft: "We've improved generation latency for long-context prompts, delivering faster responses for complex queries." Short and non-technical.
Marco P: ops-bot: can we get an automated post after canary with key metrics?
ops-bot: scheduled metric report will post at 1982469000 to this thread: p50/p95 latency, error rate, and QPS by endpoint.
Samir K: I'll paste the final internal slack copy here once Lee confirms the pin for longgen.
Lee H: Confirmed: longgen-prod pins to model-long-v1 for initial 2h (quant variant tests failed perf parity).
Elena M: Final internal announce (ready to paste):
Elena M: "Release v2.4.1 rolling at 09:00 PT. Includes runtime kernel updates, KV cache reliability fixes, and batching adjustments. Expect 10-20% latency improvement for long-context workloads. Change window 09:00-10:30 PT. On-call: @eng-oncall. If you see increased 5xxs or p95 regressions, pin affected endpoint to model-legacy-v1 and ping #eng-sre. Canary metrics will be posted in this thread at 09:10 and 09:50.
Elena M: (Pinned matrix: longgen-prod -> model-long-v1 pinned for 2h; chat-prod -> model-chat-v2 (no pin); rerank -> model-rerank-v1 (no pin))"
Samir K: Perfect. I'll post to #all-hands and schedule the pinned post in eng-releases.
Marco P: Deploy progressing: canary healthy at 09:12, p95 -8%, error rate 0.2%. ops-bot will post full metrics soon.
ops-bot: metrics report: p50 -12%, p95 -7.8%, errors 0.22%, canary QPS stable.
Dave R: Looks good. Thanks everyone — I'll be on standby for any rollbacks.
Elena M: Thanks team. I'll close the draft and paste to #all-hands in 10. :thumbsup:
